Design and architect technical solutions that address stakeholder needs while adhering to best practices, industry standards, and Pfizer's technology strategies.

Ensure compliance with relevant regulations, security protocols, and industry best practices related to solution development and deployment.
Act as technical lead for Pfizer.com (and functionality shared with our regional sites): accountable for the technical strategy, in close coordination with Platform team and other technical partners.
Strategic Leadership & Delivery
Take risk-based approach to advance innovative processes and methodologies based on comprehensive business knowledge for evaluation and recommendation of appropriate technologies, platforms, and frameworks, considering factors such as scalability, performance, security, and integration with existing systems.

Manages and leads people, technological and financial resources within the Business Unit, often lead by influence rather than direct authority, in addition to direct reports.

Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including the Technical Services Leads and Platform teams, to ensure seamless integration and support for solutions with Pfizer's digital platforms and technologies.

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field.

Passion for exploring emerging technologies and driving innovation in the field of GenAI/LLM/Semantic Search (several related efforts underway looking for leadership and individually contribution)
Strong attention to detail and commitment to delivering high-quality, robust, and scalable technical solutions.
Familiarity with agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban), continuous integration, continuous deployment (CI/CD) processes and JIRA/Confluence

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

Advanced degree or relevant certifications.
Experience in the Pharma industry
Experience with Microsoft Technology Stack, including .NET framework & SharePoint, and demonstrated understanding of cloud application architectures
Familiarity with front end modern application frameworks and tools such as node.js, Angular.js, Ionic, Apple Swift, kotlin, Vue.js. and / or back end frameworks and tools such as Java, Laravel, Drupal, Python, PHP.
High proficiency and proven successful delivery of experiences using Agile development, especially scaled agile and lean techniques and methodologies (Disciplined Agile, SAFe, etc.)
